title: Florida signs 'Teddy Bridgewater Act' into law

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Florida signs 'Teddy Bridgewater Act' into law
sources.description: Florida has signed the "Teddy Bridgewater Act" into law, meaning high school coaches in the state will now be able to use their own money to help their players with expenses such as food, transportation, physical therapy and rehabilitation services.
